units.source_text: 每當靜子從雜誌社下班回家，我便可以換班外出，前往高円寺車站附近的攤鋪和小酒館，喝便宜的燒酒。

en.t: Whenever Shizuko came home from work at the magazine office, I could take my turn going out to the stalls and little bars near Koenji Station and drink cheap shochu.

units.source_text: 等心情喝得稍微變好，才返回公寓。

en.t: After I had drunk enough for my mood to improve a little, I would return to the apartment.

units.source_text: 我對靜子說：「越看越覺得你長著一張古怪的臉。

en.t: I said to Shizuko, "The more I look at you, the stranger your face seems.

units.source_text: 悠閒和尚的造型，其實就是從你的睡容中獲得的靈感。」

en.t: The look of my carefree monk actually came from your sleeping face."

units.source_text: 「你的睡容看起來也很蒼老啊，就像四十多歲的男人。」

en.t: "Your sleeping face looks awfully old too, like a man in his forties."

units.source_text: 「還不都是你害的，都快被你榨乾了。

en.t: "It is all your fault. You have practically drained me dry.

units.source_text: 人生恰似水流動，何須憂心河邊柳。」

en.t: Life is like flowing water, so why fret over the willow by the river?"
"Stop fooling around and go to sleep.
Or would you like something to eat?"

units.source_text: 靜子心平氣和，根本不理睬我那一套。

en.t: Shizuko stayed perfectly calm and paid no attention to my performance at all.
